senses.gloss:
Meṣa denotes ‘ram’ in the Rigveda and later, while Meṣī means ‘sheep.’ Both words are also used to denote the ‘wool’ of the sheep, especially as employed for the soma filter. A wild (āraṇya) ram is mentioned in the Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā.
